notes: CONTRACT BREAK (second one, smaller than meditation.feedback): interpretation_nothing, interpretation_intro and interpretation_detail have zero usages in the app. The explanation screen (lib/presentation/screens/meditation/meditation_player/meditation_feedback/widgets/meditation_vibes_interpretation.dart) builds its caption text from a hardcoded _fallbackSubtitleFor() switch plus bundled/CMS VTT subtitle files, and the four real variants it can show (both-hands-cool, something-but-no-cool, something-with-cool, both-hands-nothing) do not correspond one-to-one with these three keys. Kept in `order` under 'Currently unused — needs a product decision' rather than marked dead — product needs to decide whether to wire the screen to these keys, replace them with a per-variant set, or drop them.
The English seed values for these three keys are also stale/shorter than what the screen actually says, which is further evidence they were abandoned rather than temporarily disconnected.

back_to_explanation is shared: it is the primary button on BOTH the 'Skip vibes check?' screen and the 'Return to meditation?' screen. It is listed once, in the skip-prompt section, and its description says so. Any wording chosen must read correctly in both places.

question_prefix / left_hand / right_hand / question_suffix are concatenated into one sentence at runtime. Languages that put the possessive or adjective in a different position may not be translatable with this split — flag if a translator reports it.
intro_question and question_prefix contain deliberate line breaks that control how the heading wraps; they must be preserved.

notes: CONFIRMED CONTRACT BREAK — all 8 keys have zero usages in the app. Verified by grepping the whole app repo: there is no `context.el....feedback` accessor anywhere in lib/ for this leaf. The strings exist only in assets/l10n/en.yaml (top-level `path_meditation_feedback:`, lines 516-524) and in the generated localization/lib/localization.dart; nothing reads them.

The screen hardcodes the same English strings inline: lib/presentation/screens/meditation/meditation_player/meditation_feedback/widgets/meditation_feedback_form.dart line 73 ('How was your experience?' = title), line 88 ('Did you enjoy the meditation? What was good and what could be improved?' = description), line 102 ('Please write at least 50 characters' = error_length), line 120 ('Type here..' = hint), line 151 ('Send' = send). The thank-you half is in widgets/meditation_feedback_thank_you.dart: line 44 ('Thank you!' = thank_you), 'Your feedback\nhelps us improve\nthis app' (= thank_you_description) and 'Close' (= close).

Because the hardcoded strings are character-for-character identical to the seed values, this looks like a screen that was built before the copy was moved into the translation system and never rewired — not an intentional removal.

KEPT, NOT DELETED, per instruction: the fix is a one-line-per-string app change (swap the literals for the l10n accessors), which is a product/engineering decision, not a translation decision. If that change ships, the whole 'Currently unused' section should be re-sectioned into the normal screen order: title, description, error_length, hint, send | thank_you, thank_you_description, close — which is the order they are already listed in.

Note the naming mismatch worth checking during that fix: the CMS leaf is meditation.feedback / meditation_feedback, but the English seed lives under the top-level `path_meditation_feedback:` node in en.yaml, not under `meditation:`. Whoever wires this up must confirm which node the app will actually read.
thank_you_description contains deliberate line breaks that shape the card; they must be preserved if the text is ever used.
The tab title has been set to 'Feedback (not shown in the app)' so a translator can see from the tab list that this leaf is inert. The slug is unchanged.
